tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Deepest ground: 3D scene backdrops, code blocks, the footer. Taken from the logo's shadow tone.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background. The banner's ground — every page starts here.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, docs sidebar, menus.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fills, inputs, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: The banner's 32px blueprint grid lines behind heroes. Decorative only, never a divider.

tokens.name: line-200
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between sections, table rules, card frames. Decorative; never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-300
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, search, outlined tags). Holds 3:1 on surface-000 through surface-300.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Cream. Headlines and primary text on every surface (12.7:1 or better). The 'Going' half of the wordmark.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Body copy and taglines on every surface (9.5:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Kickers, metadata, captions on every surface (7.2:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Mottos, timestamps, line numbers on surface-000 to surface-200 (5.5:1+); on surface-300 it is 4.98:1 — keep it 14px+.

tokens.name: copper
tokens.usage: THE brand colour — the G mark and 'Rusting' in the wordmark. Org pages and RustingEngine. Text-safe on every surface (6.2:1+).

tokens.name: copper-strong
tokens.usage: Hover state of copper fills and links.

tokens.name: copper-deep
tokens.usage: Shaded side faces of the 3D G and copper scene geometry in shadow. Not for text.

tokens.name: verdigris
tokens.usage: RustingBrain's material: the green patina copper grows. Text-safe on every surface (7.7:1+).

tokens.name: verdigris-strong
tokens.usage: Hover state of verdigris fills and links.

tokens.name: cobalt
tokens.usage: RustingShader's material: cobalt-blue glass, deep space and water. Text-safe on every surface (6.3:1+).

tokens.name: cobalt-strong
tokens.usage: Hover state of cobalt fills and links.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The current project's material. Primary buttons, active nav, links, focus of a page. Components use accent, never a project colour directly, so data-theme reskins them.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Hover state of accent fills and links.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted grounds: active sidebar item, tip callouts, accent tags. Text on it stays ink or accent.

tokens.name: accent-line
tokens.usage: Accent hairlines: framed code cards, current tutorial step, the kicker dash at low emphasis.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill, in every theme (7.5:1 or better). Never white.

tokens.name: scene-hot
tokens.usage: Second colour of the 3D scenes: the cream cap of the G, copper signals firing through Brain's neurons, the white-hot inner rim of Shader's accretion disk.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Completed tutorial steps, passing benchmarks. Always with a check icon or word.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning callouts, experimental tags. Always with an icon and the word 'Warning'.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Breaking changes, errors. Always with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: syntax-keyword
tokens.usage: Code: keywords (fn, let, use, mut). Copper in every theme — code is the org's voice.

tokens.name: syntax-type
tokens.usage: Code: types and traits (GameScene, Optimizer).

tokens.name: syntax-fn
tokens.usage: Code: function and method names.

tokens.name: syntax-string
tokens.usage: Code: string literals.

tokens.name: syntax-number
tokens.usage: Code: numbers and units.

tokens.name: syntax-macro
tokens.usage: Code: macros (rusting_game!, vec!) and attributes.

tokens.name: syntax-comment
tokens.usage: Code: comments, on surface-000 only (5.1:1).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The home hero wordmark only. 'Going' in ink, 'Rusting' in copper. 48px under 720px wide.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Project names on welcome panels and project landing pages. 40px under 720px.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Section titles inside docs; section titles on the home page.

styles.name: body-l
styles.usage: Ledes and taglines under display type.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Choose which objects need CPU authority and which the GPU owns.
styles.usage: Docs prose, panel copy. 72ch max line length.

styles.name: body-s
styles.sample: Requires Vulkan 1.2 and a recent stable Rust.
styles.usage: Sidebar items, card descriptions, table cells.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Uppercase kickers above headlines, always after a 32px copper dash. Uppercase via CSS text-transform.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Benchmark figures. Only measured numbers, always with the hardware in a caption.

styles.name: code-inline
styles.usage: Inline code in prose, on surface-300.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in tags.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in buttons; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps between tags and between buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact), mobile side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, gaps in grids.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: The blueprint grid pitch; desktop side gutter.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Banner inset; hero padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between home-page sections.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default. The G is square-capped and mitered; so is the UI.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, kbd keys, inline code — softens without rounding.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Only the outer frame of a framed banner or media card, as on the GitHub banner.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots only.

chamfer.note: The 45° corner cut from the G mark. Applied with clip-path or a gradient on the top-left corner (and bottom-right on buttons).

tokens.name: chamfer-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, chapter markers.

tokens.name: chamfer-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs.

tokens.name: chamfer-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, code cards, project index tiles.

tokens.name: chamfer-xl
tokens.usage: Full project panels' content frames.

tokens.name: glow-accent
tokens.usage: Hover on project tiles, the current tutorial step. Light comes from the material, never a grey drop shadow.

tokens.name: lift
tokens.usage: Floating code cards and menus over 3D scenes.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on everything: a 2px ground gap, then a 2px cream ring (12.7:1+ on every surface).

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover colour changes.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Tile lift, menu open.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Section reveal on scroll.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the site container.

tokens.name: prose-max
tokens.usage: Max width of docs articles.

tokens.name: sidebar-w
tokens.usage: Docs left navigation.

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: Site header height.
